Mock scheme 1 for UI verification only.

An Eastern celestial fantasy: a celestial maiden stands on a cliffside terrace of a Song-dynasty-style timber pavilion, gazing sideways over a sea of clouds. An old pine reaches out from the rock face, and a distant waterfall descends through the clouds. A medium-long shot from slightly behind her side places her on the left third, with the vast cloud sea opening to the right. Cool gray dawn light is accented by a warm beam grazing her sleeve and the wooden railing. Cinematic realism with detailed wood, stone and silk textures. A horizontal 16:9 composition.

Mock scheme 5 for UI verification only.

An Eastern celestial fantasy: a celestial maiden stands on a cliffside terrace of a Song-dynasty-style timber pavilion, gazing sideways over a sea of clouds. An old pine reaches out from the rock face, and a distant waterfall descends through the clouds. A medium-long shot from slightly behind her side places her on the left third, with the vast cloud sea opening to the right. Cool gray dawn light is accented by a warm beam grazing her sleeve and the wooden railing. Cinematic realism with detailed wood, stone and silk textures. A horizontal 16:9 composition.
